name: io.github.ChanghuLiu/england-works-watch
description: Evidence-backed England Skilled Worker sponsor-compliance change-impact decisions for Home Office/UKVI sponsor reporting. Supported events include absence, salary, role or occupation-code changes, work-location or home-working changes, delayed starts, stopping sponsorship or worker departure, organisation changes, TUPE transfers, and mergers/takeovers. One-event and batch decisions remain evidence-linked and fail closed when inputs or official source evidence are insufficient.
